about.introduce: Hello, I'm Balasanjeev, a Computer Science Engineering student with a strong foundation in Full Stack Development, and Machine Learning. I have hands-on experience building scalable web applications and secure backend systems. My flagship project, Deptic, is a full-stack platform that automates GitHub dependency vulnerability scanning, security fix pull requests, SBOM generation, and compliance reporting. I also led the development of Nandha Notes, a collaborative notes-sharing platform for students, and developed an AI-powered PDF chatbot during my internship. These experiences have strengthened my skills in software engineering, system design, API development, and problem-solving. I'm passionate about building reliable, secure, and impactful software, and I'm seeking opportunities as a Full Stack Developer, Backend Developer, or Software Engineer where I can contribute effectively while continuing to learn and grow.
